g.text: The maker's two 10 k I2C pull-ups were dropped (the badge provides them; docs/standard.md section 1). Mode button = the XIAO's own BOOT button.

g.desc: The maker's two 10 k I2C pull-ups were dropped (the badge provides them; docs/standard.md section 1). Mode button = the XIAO's own BOOT button.

g.text: R2, R3: 330 ohm on the SAO GPIO pins per docs/standard.md. R1: 330 ohm on the LED data line. R4: 330 ohm in the OFF sense line (harmless; it lets the badge 3.3 V track cross it). R2, R3 and R4 each let one other track pass between their pads: the board is routed on the back copper only.

g.desc: R2, R3: 330 ohm on the SAO GPIO pins per docs/standard.md. R1: 330 ohm on the LED data line. R4: 330 ohm in the OFF sense line (harmless; it lets the badge 3.3 V track cross it). R2, R3 and R4 each let one other track pass between their pads: the board is routed on the back copper only.

g.text: D1..D4 = SK6805 side-firing RGB round the bottom of the helmet, chained D1 (right, seen from the front) to D4 (left), as on the original. C1 = 100 nF at the LEDs' supply.

g.desc: D1..D4 = SK6805 side-firing RGB round the bottom of the helmet, chained D1 (right, seen from the front) to D4 (left), as on the original. C1 = 100 nF at the LEDs' supply.

g.text: Do not plug in USB with the switch on SAO while on a badge: two 3.3 V regulators would share one rail.

g.desc: Do not plug in USB with the switch on SAO while on a badge: two 3.3 V regulators would share one rail.

g.text: On USB the XIAO powers the rail itself. In OFF the firmware sees D1 high and blanks the LEDs. No coin cell and no LiPo connector on this board (no room: see README).

g.desc: On USB the XIAO powers the rail itself. In OFF the firmware sees D1 high and blanks the LEDs. No coin cell and no LiPo connector on this board (no room: see README).

g.text: Power: the switch common is the 3.3 V rail (XIAO 3V3 pin and the LEDs). Position 1 = badge 3.3 V feeds the rail. Position 2 (OFF) ties D1 to the rail; position 3 (USB) leaves the badge disconnected.

g.desc: Power: the switch common is the 3.3 V rail (XIAO 3V3 pin and the LEDs). Position 1 = badge 3.3 V feeds the rail. Position 2 (OFF) ties D1 to the rail; position 3 (USB) leaves the badge disconnected.
